scope: All30 current canonical owned-feature size findings; pure parser only, no full architecture acceptance. Original22 requested signals remain mapped, including below-threshold TaskCard.

records.responsibility: One local admission/acknowledgement/reconciliation state machine over the canonical QueryClient, shared by actual Onboard writers.
records.boundary: Pending records are installed before dispatch, current owner guards fence continuations, and exact-record comparison prevents late writes after replacement. Native authority/idempotency remain in the service.
records.decision: Retain this cohesive state machine; no extra provider, durable storage, generic transport or backend workflow is introduced.

records.responsibility: One reviewed role-designation form including self/invite choice and required super-admin selection.
records.boundary: Native request/response validation is the root fixed-operation owner; local inputs, pending freeze and current-read navigation belong to this screen.
records.decision: Retain the single form and its row editing together. The file signal covers this form and its small route selector, not independent lifecycle owners.

records.responsibility: One reviewed role-designation form including self/invite choice and required super-admin selection.
records.boundary: Native request/response validation is the root fixed-operation owner; local inputs, pending freeze and current-read navigation belong to this screen.
records.decision: Retain the single form and its row editing together. The file signal covers this form and its small route selector, not independent lifecycle owners.

records.responsibility: One provisioning bridge: explicit admission, current status/read-only polling, failure recovery and the reviewed workspace summary.
records.boundary: Provisioning is never started on mount. Native session-scoped status reads and the attempt journal fence replacement; progress is presentation, not an implementation of provisioning.
records.decision: Retain this single bridge pending independent review; all provider/queue/charge/delivery work remains outside it. Its long body is mostly status/summary markup.

records.decision: Retain this single bridge pending independent review; all provider/queue/charge/delivery work remains outside it. Its long body is mostly status/summary markup.

records.responsibility: One agreement-review and acceptance ceremony with reusable document blocks and signed-PDF download.
records.boundary: Current native-session/plan reads select exact document versions; frozen signer inputs and guarded acceptance/read/download preserve the reviewed intent.
records.decision: Retain the legal ceremony; document rendering and download are closely bound to the same accepted versions. Native legal validation/storage stays external.

records.boundary: Current native-session/plan reads select exact document versions; frozen signer inputs and guarded acceptance/read/download preserve the reviewed intent.
records.decision: Retain the legal ceremony; document rendering and download are closely bound to the same accepted versions. Native legal validation/storage stays external.

records.responsibility: One organization profile/contact form.
records.boundary: The form submits existing native merge operands; downstream display waits for an actual session read. Logo selection remains local and unavailable for upload.
records.decision: Retain cohesive profile fields; no invented clear/remove/logo contract or optimistic model owner.

records.responsibility: Paid subscription review: profile quantity, contact, selected method, explicit subscription preparation and current payment-status action.
records.boundary: The SDK owner is StripePayment; local unknown/confirmed journals prevent repetition and invoice navigation uses the root narrow validator. Pricing copy is server-projected public data.
records.decision: Retain this independent paid workflow. Trial flow, shared controls, SDK loading/confirmation, transport and pricing export have separate owners; 413-line module contains one paid workflow, not both checkout lifecycles.

records.responsibility: Paid subscription review: profile quantity, contact, selected method, explicit subscription preparation and current payment-status action.
records.boundary: The SDK owner is StripePayment; local unknown/confirmed journals prevent repetition and invoice navigation uses the root narrow validator. Pricing copy is server-projected public data.
records.decision: Retain this independent paid workflow. Trial flow, shared controls, SDK loading/confirmation, transport and pricing export have separate owners; 413-line module contains one paid workflow, not both checkout lifecycles.

records.responsibility: Plan selection and review before payment is committed.
records.boundary: Local presentation consumes server-projected price copy and advances only from current native session state.
records.decision: Retain one form and its explanatory bullets; no billing effect or pricing constants are duplicated.

records.responsibility: Explicit account/firm registration with identity-bound draft restore, Clerk form errors and activation handoff.
records.boundary: Known Clerk input refusals may allow corrected input; ambiguous effects are journaled. Activation availability and current owner are checked before invocation.
records.decision: Retain this registration form; root owns Clerk provider/token/routing authority, and no implicit register retry is present.

records.responsibility: Trial payment-method review: explicit SetupIntent preparation, selected card/ACH/wire and native trial-complete handoff.
records.boundary: Client secrets exist only in component state/SDK props; shared confirmation owner seals SDK success before native continuation. Current native session binds the editor and journals.
records.decision: Retain separate trial flow. It has no paid subscription/profile-tier branch; card/ACH element plumbing is extracted.

records.responsibility: Explicit send/resend/code verification and current funnel verification review.
records.boundary: It invokes existing Clerk/root API methods only after intent; no mount send/register or POST polling, and authority replacement ends continuations.
records.decision: Retain one verification workflow and its input/error states.

records.responsibility: One invite-capability review, current provider availability, explicit consent or skip and help copy.
records.boundary: Root validates consent destinations and capability transport; token-keyed view/attempt replacement fences stale continuations.
records.decision: Retain capability presentation; no provider fallback, auth provider duplication or fabricated grant.

records.responsibility: One explicit Clerk invitation ticket acceptance, password setup and activation handoff.
records.boundary: Ticket-keyed view lifetime and local journal retain uncertainty without automatic ticket submission.
records.decision: Retain the acceptance flow; outer canonical session owns subsequent authenticated setup.

records.responsibility: Firm-memory proposal editing across the three existing firm file types.
records.boundary: Existing active sections and pending candidate metadata are distinct; proposed text remains local and pending receipts do not mark active content saved.
records.decision: Retain this editor; no review/approval/CAS endpoint is fabricated.

records.responsibility: Setup card for current profile import progress and Capiro-managed versus self-import presentation.
records.boundary: Pure current state and onOpen callback; no API, effect or query ownership.
records.decision: Keep separate from email/team cards because import capacity and managed-service messaging change independently.

records.responsibility: Current email-provider setup task states and IT contact/resend input presentation.
records.boundary: Typed subset of SetupActions provides guarded callbacks; this component owns no transport or effect admission.
records.decision: Keep email status/input together; membership activation, other task transitions and overlay orchestration are separate.

records.responsibility: Registrant search results and deliberate firm/manual-path selection.
records.boundary: Typed subset of the persistent import workflow; success/error/empty/keyboard states remain visible without creating a new read or mutation owner.
records.decision: Keep search presentation distinct from manual client creation and candidate selection.

records.responsibility: One filed-client row with spend/filing facts and keyboard/selection state.
records.boundary: Pure candidate facts and a toggle callback; no query, cache or network activity.
records.decision: Keep row formatting and disabled/selected semantics together; extracted from the candidate map with compiled JSX equivalence.

records.responsibility: Review of current filed clients, capacity, selection and confirmed/unknown import outcomes.
records.boundary: The persistent workflow owns reads/imports; this view freezes unresolved selections and exposes explicit current-status recovery. Billing navigation opens existing settings with no implicit effect.
records.decision: Keep this results/review view separate from search and manual entry; rows have their own pure presentation.

records.responsibility: Review team invitations, per-recipient receipts and separate explicit setup completion.
records.boundary: Sequential invitation helper stops at uncertainty, preserves earlier invitation IDs, and never sends remaining rows automatically. Native completeSetup must confirm completion.
records.decision: Retain this invitation ceremony; it does not own general setup task state or IT consent.

records.responsibility: Manual client input and confirmed local creation-count display.
records.boundary: Typed callbacks/state from the persistent import workflow; pending fields stay frozen and current count refresh precedes clearing.
records.decision: Keep manual entry distinct from LDA search/candidates; markup is compiled-JSX equivalent to the preserved form.

records.responsibility: Thin setup entry gating loaded identity, organization membership, and current setup reads.
records.boundary: No setup mutation is in the entry. It composes WorkspaceMembership or SetupWorkspace and provides a validated current refresh.
records.decision: Retain the 83-line entry including loading/error markup; membership and task work are extracted.

records.responsibility: Composition of current setup progress, task panels and the selected overlay.
records.boundary: Guarded actions are in useSetupActions; email/import task markup is separate, and each overlay owns its own workflow.
records.decision: Retain this current-workspace composition. It contains no Clerk membership switching or chunk/invitation implementation.

records.responsibility: Explicit membership selection, including legacy-workspace switching and no-membership guidance.
records.boundary: Clerk supplies membership facts; root owns activation effects/authority replacement, and the local journal prevents concurrent/unknown activation retries.
records.decision: Keep membership separate from setup reads, IT invitations, task transitions and import fields.

records.responsibility: Persistent local import workflow across search/manual/table views: read selection, draft fields, reviewed operations and recovery.
records.boundary: Chunk/partial receipt semantics stay in useClientImport/importClientSelection; native schemas/API stay shared. The hook keeps draft/uncertain outcomes stable as presentation views switch.
records.decision: Retain the cohesive225-line controller. Extracted views consume typed Pick interfaces; no independent cache, provider, transport or generic orchestration framework.

records.responsibility: Guarded IT invitation/resend and explicit task transition callbacks for the current setup workspace.
records.boundary: Existing shared setup API and local journal own the boundary; current refresh failures remain failures, and pending input clears only after successful refresh.
records.decision: Keep related setup actions in one89-line hook; membership and per-recipient team invitation sequencing are separate.

records.responsibility: OptionCard presentation with native keyboard/selected/disabled semantics.
records.boundary: Local visual/input primitive only, no effect or authority owner.
records.decision: Retain one coherent option-card component rather than fragment styling and event semantics.
